title: UN watchdog 'increasingly concerned' over uninspected Iran nuclear site
summary:

Under a 2015 nuclear deal, Iran agreed to limit its enriched uranium stockpile to 300kg and enrichment to 3.67% purity.

summary:

The country’s Ministry of Territorial ‌Administration said late on Thursday that clashes occurred on Wednesday, when defence and security forces were verifying the implementation of a ban on artisanal gold mining.
The violence erupted in Balato, in the Siguiri region, during a patrol against illegal and unregulated gold mining.
Guinea banned artisanal gold mining in Siguiri on November 2.
Artisanal and small-scale gold mining supports the livelihoods of more than 300,000 people in Guinea, according to the UN Environment Programme.
